fixtureNotes: The fixture server on :5296 stopped answering after the keyboard run (chrome-error://chromewebdata, no listener). It is a static directory, so it was brought back with `python3 -m http.server 5296 -d /tmp/minion-design-durability-render --bind 127.0.0.1` (same files, same port); all cells from editable-grid-keyboard onward were measured against that server. Earlier cells were measured against the original server.

recipes.html?recipe=calendar renders only PageShell+PageHeader+"New task" (Recipes.svelte has no calendar branch). Its cells therefore cover the shell only; the region-scroll and 44px checks for a calendar body are not covered.

Themes are applied as data-minion-theme=<id> on <html> plus an inline style block of token overrides; data-theme=<id> is set only for the decorated ids (crt, voxelized, obsidian). Contrast was computed from the resolved custom properties (canvas-resolved to sRGB bytes, alpha composited over --color-canvas).
